text: Let's move like animals with a grown-up! Make a little space together. You can try every move while sitting down.
A rabbit hops! Play with your grown-up. Make little hops with your hands, or try a gentle hop together.
A cat stretches! Reach your arms out slowly, then bring them back. A little stretch feels good.
A dog wags its tail! Pretend your hand is a tail. Wag it gently from side to side.
A horse trots! Pat your knees one at a time. Clip, clop, clip, clop!
A chicken flaps its wings! Bend your elbows and give your little wings a gentle flap.
A duck waddles! Sit or stand with your grown-up and gently rock from side to side.
A goat climbs! Pretend your fingers are little feet. Walk them slowly up your other arm.
A sheep walks through the grass! Take tiny steps in place, or walk two fingers across your lap.
A pig sniffs with its snout! Wiggle your nose and take a little sniff. What a curious pig!
A turkey can spread its tail feathers! Spread your fingers wide like a fan, then relax your hands.
A dolphin swims through the water! Move one hand up and down like a gentle ocean wave.
A crab can walk sideways! Walk your fingers sideways across your lap, or take little side steps with your grown-up.
An octopus moves its arms! Wiggle your fingers and slowly wave your arms through our pretend ocean.
A seal swims with flippers! Keep your elbows close and gently sweep your hands through pretend water.
A jellyfish squeezes its body to swim! Open your hands wide, then gently close them. Open and close!
A stingray glides through the sea! Hold your arms out a little and move them softly up and down.
